patthana23.17:1.1: na kusalo na paccuppanno dhammo kusalassa paccuppannassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo:.
patthana23.17:2.1: ārammaṇe aṭṭhārasa. nakusalattika naatītārammaṇattike kusalattika atītārammaṇattikaṃ
patthana23.17:3.1: na kusalaṃ na atītārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato atītārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.17:4.1: na kusalaṃ na anāgatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo anāgatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā nava.
patthana23.17:5.1: na kusalaṃ na paccuppannārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato paccuppannārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nakusalattika naajjhattārammaṇattike kusalattika ajjhattārammaṇattikaṃ
